title: The Official letter from the council
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：official　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 official 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the trader wrote of ① an official letter from the council in the list, and everybody in the market said at once that it was ② so official that nobody in the market would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the trader, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the official ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the official letter from the council that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list for October 1969 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too official to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the partner who had come to help; the official ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far stall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an official visit of the mayor, and said that no partner in his right mind would call it ⑥ as official as the visit of the mayor they had once had in the old market. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was official or not, and he said so.

By 1982 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was ⑦ something official, and nothing besides. The partner from the next market called the whole plan ⑧ quite official; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the list kept the names of the official ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1985, before dawn, she wrote of another official letter from the council in the same list, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less official than anybody had expected. ⑩ The official visit of the mayor that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1987, was the one she could never quite name; the official ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 官方（前置定语 an official letter from the council：1975 年货商在货单里记下的那件官方的正式公函）
B. adj. 官方／正式（两处加强说法：so official that … 与 no less official than …）
C. adj. 官方／正式（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 官方（表语 too official to do：母亲觉得它太官方，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 正式（前置定语 an official visit of the mayor：叔叔把整件事称作一桩正式的官方访问）
F. adj. 正式（同级比较 as official as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩镇长的官方访问相比）
G. adj. 正式（后置定语 something official：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 正式（受程度副词修饰 quite official：那位伙计的评价）

items.q: an official letter from the council
the official letter from the council that
an official visit of the mayor
The official visit of the mayor that

answers.why: official 意为“官方”，1975 年货商在货单里记下的是“一件官方的正式公函”，此处作前置定语 an official letter from the council。
official 意为“官方”，此处用 so official that 结构，说它官方到集市里没人敢靠近。
official 意为“官方”，货单上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的官方议会的正式公函，等于最高级的说法。
official 意为“官方”，母亲认为这件东西“太官方了，谁也用不上”，too official to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
official 意为“正式”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩正式的官方访问”，此处作前置定语 an official visit of the mayor。
official 意为“正式”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩镇长的官方访问一样正式”，同级比较用 as official as。
official 意为“正式”，货单上那半行字要的是“正式的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something official。
official 意为“正式”，邻集市来的那位伙计认为这套计划“相当正式”，quite 修饰原级 official。
official 意为“正式”，no less official than 表示“其正式不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之正式不亚于任何人的预料。
official 意为“正式”，母亲 1987 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的正式官方访问”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年，货商在货单里记下了一件官方的正式公函。（an official letter from the council）
它官方到集市里没有一个人敢靠近。（so official that …）
母亲觉得它太官方，谁也用不上。（too official to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩正式的官方访问。（an official visit of the mayor）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩镇长的官方访问一样正式。（as official as …）
到了 1982 年，货单上只剩半行字：要的是一件正式的东西。（something official）
answers: In 1975 the trader wrote of an official letter from the council in the list.
It was so official that nobody in the market would go near it.
My mother thought it too official to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an official visit of the mayor.
He said nobody would call it as official as the visit of the mayor they had once had.
By 1982 the list asked for nothing but something official.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 official 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the trader wrote of an official letter from the council in the list, and nobody forgot it.
It was the official letter from the council that anybody there had ever seen, or so the list says.
My mother thought it too official to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an official visit of the mayor, and nobody argued with him.
The partner from the next market called the plan quite official, and everybody laughed.
The official ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
